summary: Explains loop_control break_when (2.18+) to exit a loop early based on Jinja2 expressions, with an example generating passwords until one matches a policy, and using register projections in break_when.
questions: How do I break out of a loop early in Ansible?
How do I stop looping once a condition is met?
Can I retry generating a password until it meets a policy?

answer_card.title: Breaking out of a loop with break_when
answer_card.answer_md:
Since 2.18:

```yaml
- set_fact:
    password: "{{ lookup('password', '/dev/null', chars=character_set, length=12) }}"
  loop: "{{ range(0, 10) }}"
  loop_control:
    break_when:
      - password is match(password_policy)
```

With register projections:

```yaml
loop: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]
loop_control:
  break_when: items_processed == 2
register:
  items_processed: _task.loop_result.results | length
```
